environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS with Fluent Bit sidecar collecting from /var/log/app/audit.log. Fluent Bit configuration uses the 'tail' input plugin with multiline parser set to 'docker' mode and a custom parser that applies Lua filter script performing RFC 5424 structured-data normalization before forwarding to OpenSearch. The Lua filter (fluent-bit/scripts/normalize.lua) replaces all control characters including \n, \r, \x0a, \x0d in field values with Unicode replacement character U+FFFD before serialization. Pod runs with read-only root filesystem except /var/log/app mount. Istio sidecar enforces mTLS but does not inspect request bodies. HSM access via AWS CloudHSM with IAM role scoped to sign operations only.

config.log_pipeline: Fluent Bit 2.2 sidecar with tail input, custom Lua filter normalize.lua strips control chars from all string fields before output
config.lua_filter: function cb_filter(tag, timestamp, record) for k,v in pairs(record) do if type(v) == 'string' then record[k] = v:gsub('[%c]', '\xEF\xBF\xBD') end end return 2, timestamp, record end
config.log_sink: Amazon OpenSearch with index-per-day, no raw line ingestion
config.network: Istio mTLS sidecar, no request body inspection
config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM, IAM role with cloudhsm:Sign only
